## Copy Diagnostics

Run **Copy Diagnostics** from the command palette (Mod+Shift+P, then type
"diagnostics") and paste the result between the fences. It carries the
version, the platform, what recently went wrong, and the last host crash if
there was one. Your home directory is stripped from the paths before it
reaches the clipboard; check the paste anyway if you would rather not share
a filename.

```
(paste here)
```
